intent: Verify whether the Scheppach Workshop HS 1OA-DTT compressor variant (machine type compressor, 230 V, 2200 W) exists and whether it supports voice control; answer NO with the checked SKU if the base product exists but voice control is absent.
success_criteria: Base product matching brand Scheppach, model HS 1OA-DTT, machine_type=compressor, voltage=230, power=2200 is resolved to an exact product_sku and record_path
Presence/absence of the voice_control capability on that SKU is determined from product_variant_properties
If base exists but voice_control absent, answer contains <NO> token and the checked SKU
Answer cites the exact product record path

args.stdin:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT v.product_sku, v.record_path, v.product_name, v.brand, v.model
  FROM product_variants v
  JOIN product_variant_properties mt
    ON mt.product_sku = v.product_sku AND mt.property_key = 'machine_type'
  JOIN product_variant_properties pv
    ON pv.product_sku = v.product_sku AND pv.property_key = 'voltage'
  JOIN product_variant_properties pw
    ON pw.product_sku = v.product_sku AND pw.property_key = 'power'
  WHERE v.brand = :brand
    AND v.model = :model
    AND lower(mt.property_value_text) = lower(:machine_type)
    AND CAST(pv.property_value_number AS INTEGER) = CAST(:voltage_v AS INTEGER)
    AND CAST(pw.property_value_number AS INTEGER) = CAST(:power_w AS INTEGER)
)
SELECT b.product_sku, b.record_path, b.product_name,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_variant_properties cap
        WHERE cap.product_sku = b.product_sku
          AND cap.property_key = :capability_key) AS has_voice_control
FROM base b;

agents_md_constraints.rule: When answering yes/no questions - include <YES> or <NO> tokens in the response. This is how the agent will know how to style the response.
When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
Note that inventory lives only in SQL projections

answer_template.message: <NO> Base product Scheppach Workshop HS 1OA-DTT Compressor (machine type compressor, 230 V, 2200 W) exists as SKU {match.product_sku}, but the catalogue record has no voice_control capability. Checked SKU: {match.product_sku} ({match.record_path}).
